تخترطن (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِطْنَ (taḵtariṭna) /tax.ta.ritˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
# تُخْتَرَطْنَ (tuḵtaraṭna) /tux.ta.ratˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَطَ (iḵtaraṭa)
